setup.title: Setup
settings.tools.title: Tools
settings.tools.hint: The toolbox works through git, the GitHub CLI and its Classroom 50 extension. Missing ones install through your package manager (Homebrew, winget, apt, dnf or pacman); git and the GitHub CLI are updated by it too.
projects.empty: No Classroom 50 assignments found yet. Sign in to GitHub, or add the folder where you keep your assignments.
auth.notification.title: Signed in to GitHub
auth.notification.body: Classroom 50 Toolbox is now connected as {login}.
settings.folders.title: Assignment folders
settings.folders.hint: Scanned for Classroom 50 repositories, up to 4 levels deep.
settings.general.title: General
settings.reminders.title: Deadline reminders
settings.about.title: About
settings.dev.title: Developer
settings.dev.skinHint: Shows another platform's theme on this machine. The window backdrop stays this platform's.
settings.dev.hint: Dev builds only. Sends each kind of notification with made-up data.
settings.dev.badgeHint: Close the popover to see it; opening and closing it again clears it.
settings.quit.label: Quit
settings.quit.hint: Closing the window keeps it in the tray. Quitting stops syncs and reminders.
clone.exists: {error}. Move or rename that folder, or use Clone to… to pick another place.
projects.issue.rateLimited: GitHub rate limit reached. Showing the last known state.
projects.issue.notInstalled: Install the GitHub CLI to see your assignments on GitHub.
projects.issue.other: Couldn't reach GitHub. Showing the last known state.
settings.folders.editors: Find projects opened in your editors
settings.folders.editorsHint: JetBrains IDEs, VS Code and its forks, Zed, Sublime Text, Eclipse, NetBeans and Visual Studio
projects.unmergedBranches: Only on: {branches}. Merge into the default branch, which is what gets graded.
projects.pullHint: Someone pushed since your last pull. Pull before you keep working.
projects.gradingHint: The autograder is running on your last push. The grade shows up here when it's done.
projects.gradingFailedHint: The autograder couldn't grade your last push. Open the grading run to see why, or ask your teacher.
projects.lockedHint: Your teacher locked this assignment for now
projects.upcomingHint: Your teacher hasn't released this assignment yet
submit.confirm: This sends the files in {folder} as they are now, saved changes included, to {branch} on GitHub as a new commit. Your local commits and branches stay as they are.
submit.remoteAhead: GitHub has commits this clone doesn't have. Submitting sends your files as they are, so changes made only on GitHub are undone. Pull first to keep them.
submit.remoteAheadBy: GitHub has commits this clone doesn't have (the latest by {author}). Submitting sends your files as they are, so changes made only on GitHub are undone. Pull first to keep them.
submit.unchanged: Nothing changed since the last push: this grades the same work again.
submit.late: The due date has passed, so this submission will be marked late.
submit.noMarker: This assignment has no autograder setup to submit through. Commit and push your work with git instead.
submit.deleted: Some files were deleted without git knowing: {files}. Run git rm on them (or restore them), then submit again.
submit.done: Submitted. The autograder runs now, and the grade shows up here when it's done. Your clone is now one commit behind GitHub: click Pull to get the submission commit.
pull.localChanges: You have changes that aren't committed yet. Commit them first, then pull, so they're not mixed with the new commits.
pull.otherBranch: This clone is on another branch. Switch to {branch} to pull the new commits.
pull.diverged: Both your clone and GitHub have new commits, so they need to be merged. Pull from your editor or with git pull, and solve any conflicts there.
accept.confirm: This creates your repository for this assignment in {classroom} on GitHub.
accept.public: Heads up: this assignment uses a public repository. Your work, commits and GitHub name will be visible to anyone.
accept.group: This is a group assignment: only one member accepts it, then invites the others to the repository.
accept.teamTeacher: Your teacher assigns the groups. If you aren't in one yet, ask them to add you first.
accept.teamStudent: This is a team assignment. If a teammate already created your group, ask them to add you before accepting.
accept.needsTeam: You aren't in a group for this assignment yet. Create a new group? You can add your teammates afterwards. If a teammate already has a group, cancel and ask them to add you instead.
accept.done: {repo} is ready. It shows up in the list after the next sync.
alerts.due.title: {assignment} is due {when}
alerts.due.body: Make sure your work is committed, pushed and on the default branch.
alerts.grade.title: New grade: {assignment}
alerts.gradingFailed.title: Grading failed: {assignment}
alerts.gradingFailed.body: The autograder couldn't grade your last push. Open the assignment to see why.
alerts.feedback.title: New feedback: {assignment}
alerts.feedback.body: Your teacher commented on your feedback pull request.
alerts.newAssignment.title: New assignment in {classroom}
details.submissionMode.every-push: Every push to the default branch
details.failedTests: Failed tests (Open grade details shows why)
alerts.teammatePush.title: {author} pushed to {assignment}
alerts.groupJoined.title: {members} joined your group
alerts.groupJoined.body: {assignment}: they can push to your shared repository now.
alerts.deadlineChanged.title: Deadline changed: {assignment}
alerts.closed.title: Submissions closed: {assignment}
settings.sync.title: Sync
projects.filter.label: Show
projects.conflictHint: A teammate pushed while you have uncommitted or unpushed work. Pull now to avoid a merge conflict.
projects.lateHint: Graded work is dated after the deadline. Nothing is blocked; your teacher sees it as late.
projects.issue.offline: You're offline. Showing what was last synced.
settings.editor.label: Editor
settings.editor.hint: For clones no editor has opened yet. Others open where you last worked on them.
settings.editor.none: No supported editor found. Install one and it shows up here.
teammate.teamHint: They get push access to {assignment} through your group. Only the group's founder can add members.
teammate.inviteHint: They get a GitHub invitation to push to {repo}.
teammate.teamDone: {user} is in your group now. They should accept {assignment} next.
teammate.inviteDone: {user} got an invitation to push to {repo}.
settings.hidden.label: Hidden assignments
settings.hidden.hint: Hidden: {count}. Left out of the list and never notified about; search still finds them.
welcome.title: Welcome to Classroom 50 Toolbox
welcome.lead: Your Classroom 50 assignments, one click away in the tray.
welcome.point.list: Every assignment in one list, with its due date, grade and what still needs pushing or submitting.
welcome.point.actions: Accept, clone, pull and submit without the terminal, and open your work in your editor.
welcome.point.notify: Reminders before deadlines, and a notification when a grade, feedback or a teammate's push arrives.
welcome.tools.title: Tools
welcome.tools.missing: Classroom 50 works through git, the GitHub CLI and its gh student extension. Install what's missing; it takes a minute.
welcome.tools.ready: git, the GitHub CLI and gh student are installed. You're set.
welcome.account.title: GitHub account
welcome.account.hint: Sign in with the account your classes know you by. Your browser opens with a one-time code; the app keeps no copy of your token.
welcome.folders.title: Your code
